sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:2

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:2:1
items.html:
The root of all this dross and of these kings is one name BON: And we must understand well what this dross is, and also how it is rooted in and comes from the name BON.
And the matter is that you already know that the vessels in every Partzuf come to it from its upper one. For after the lights of the ten Sefirot of the Guf of the upper one have departed and the vessels of the ten Sefirot remain empty of light, these vessels pass over to the lower one and are filled with the lights of the lower one, as above, page 318, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “And he has already explained”; study it there well.
Accordingly, you will understand that the vessels of the nine lower ones of the Partzuf SAG of AK, which were emptied of their lights with the restriction of NHY of AK, are the very vessels of the Nekudim of AK, which is called the name BON. And it was explained in the Inner Light (above, page 390, the passage beginning “And SAG”) that the nine lower ones of SAG of AK, which expanded into the place of NHY of the Partzuf of Keter of AK, were mingled there with phase four that is found in the vessels of NHY of the Partzuf of Keter of AK (as above, page 428, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “And the reason”), where phase four was mingled into each and every Sefira as far as Hochma; see there. Thus there is a mingling of phase four in the vessels of SAG, in each and every one of their discernments. It was also explained above (page 390, the passage beginning “And SAG”) why the lights and the vessels of SAG were able to illuminate in the place of phase four of AK: because there was no restriction upon the light of SAG, which is the light of Bina, and the restriction was only upon the light of Hochma alone; study it there well. It follows accordingly that afterwards, when these vessels passed over to the ZAT of Nekudim as above, and AVI of Nekudim coupled in the coupling of Gadlut, face to face, and drew a level of Hochma in their place from below upward as a Rosh, and then bestowed this light of Hochma upon the ZAT of Nekudim, where phase four was mingled into each of their discernments, that light could not clothe itself in these vessels, since phase four is already restricted so as not to receive the light of Hochma. Therefore, when the light was drawn inside a vessel and struck phase four that was mingled in the vessel, it immediately departed and went out of all the vessels; and the vessel too was broken and died, because of phase four within it, which nursed something of the light before it departed from there. This nursing caused a disparity of form, in a manner opposite to the Emanator, who is the light of life; therefore it is called death.
Thus you find that this mingling of phase four in the vessels of SAG, which are phase two, caused breaking and death in the vessels. Therefore this mingling is called dross in the vessels, these being parts in the vessels that cannot receive the upper light; and because of them the corruption fell upon all the vessels, even upon the parts that are fit to receive the light, that is, upon the vessels of SAG, which are from phase two.
And this is what he says: when He began to create the world etc., and He began to sort the kings, and that which was sorted out of him rose into the holiness of the worlds, and that which was not sorted remained shell and dross. End of quote. For after the light departed from the vessels, and the vessels died and fell to the worlds of separation, to BYA, the Emanator then went back and sorted the broken vessels of the kings. This means that He sorted out the parts that are fit for the clothing of the upper light, which are those belonging to the vessels of SAG, as above, and these are the Partzufim of Atzilut in their portion from the side of BON. And that dross, which is mingled with phase four and was not sorted, remained in BYA inside the shells. It has thus been explained that the dross consists of the parts of phase four that were mingled into the vessels of SAG, and that this mingling was rooted in the vessels of Nekudim, which are called BON. And this is what he says, that the dross and the kings were rooted in the name BON, that is, in Nekudim.

items.html: And there are shells opposite it from its head to its feet: For the ZAT as a whole are regarded as one complete Partzuf, with a Rosh and a Guf, and this is because they received the light of GAR and a Rosh from the coupling of Gadlut of AVI, as written in Part 6. Therefore, since all the ZAT were broken both in front and behind, as written further on in this part, and since phase four was mingled into each and every one of the discernments of the vessels of Nekudim, as above, there are therefore shells in it from its head to its feet, that is, the dross that remained inside the shells, as above.
